components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confident action for the survey demonstration.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 2.9rem; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper-light); font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--terracotta); background: var(--terracotta); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { border-color: var(--line); background: var(--disabled-surface); color: var(--disabled-text); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action with an unfilled paper surface.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { min-height: 2.9rem; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-quiet:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--paper-light); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Wrapping text navigation with a terracotta active-page rule.
components.html: Start hereResources
components.css: .ds-site-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1.2rem; } .ds-site-nav a { padding: 0.65rem 0 0.8rem; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 600 0.9rem/1.4 "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-site-nav a:hover, .ds-site-nav a[aria-current="page"] { border-bottom-color: var(--terracotta); } .ds-site-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Contents Row
components.description: A ruled editorial link that opens a guide section.
components.html: Explore trusted resourcesEvidence-based guides from health organizationsRead
components.css: .ds-contents-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 0.35rem 1rem; align-items: baseline; padding: 1rem 0.1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-list-title { font: 600 1.35rem/1.2 "Newsreader", Georgia, serif; } .ds-list-note { color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 0.9rem/1.5 "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-read-cue { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; color: var(--terracotta); font: 700 0.8rem/1.4 "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-contents-row:hover .ds-list-title { color: var(--terracotta); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-contents-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-survey-question { min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 1.35rem 0 1.45rem; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-survey-question legend { max-width: 60ch; padding: 0; color: var(--ink); font: 600 1.55rem/1.25 "Newsreader", Georgia, serif; } .ds-choice-row { display: flex; align-items: start; gap: 0.7rem; max-width: 36rem; padding: 0.45rem 0; color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem/1.65 "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-choice-row input { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; margin: 0.22rem 0 0; accent-color: var(--terracotta); } .ds-choice-row input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The guide should feel like a warm, reflective note from school: personal and steady, never clinical or alarmist. Its school-paper editorial character comes from a clear reading order, generous margins, a self-hosted serif for titles, and fine rules rather than dashboard panels or decorative cards.

The visual system is for an educational project, not an official ICHB publication or a substitute for qualified support. Page labels sit beneath their headings; source links and support routes remain explicit and easy to find.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and deep green-black ink.
Editorial hierarchy with a calm sans-serif reading voice.
Thin rules, square corners, and restrained terracotta emphasis.
Responsive navigation and a compact contents rail.

rules.name: The Paper-First Rule
rules.body: Keep the warm page ground dominant; use terracotta for meaningful links and editorial marks, not large decorative fields.

rules.name: The Heading-First Rule
rules.body: Let each page's h1 lead. Place its small running label beneath it, never as an eyebrow above it.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Convey depth with paper tone and editorial rules, never with decorative shadows or glass effects.

dos: Do keep the implemented palette values and locally hosted Newsreader face.
Do place page labels below h1 and preserve the calm reading order.
Do use semantic headings, visible keyboard focus, and source-attributed support links.
Do keep the survey non-collecting unless a separately approved implementation replaces the prototype.
donts: Don't use shadows, gradients, rounded-card grids, or clinical dashboard patterns.
Don't place tracked uppercase labels above page headings.
Don't imply the school endorses this prototype or that general contact channels are private counselling.
Don't ask for names, contact details, or free-text disclosures in the demonstration survey.
